name: ImportImage

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为[2, 128]个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
